title: Vagabones Demo
description: Vagabones is a class-based roguelike action-adventure game for 1-4 players! Battle fierce foes, play minigames, solve puzzles, and collect treasures as you venture through the Shadowmoon Kingdom to defeat the Calico King!

title: Cyber Rail Demo
description: Cyber Rail is a frenetic roguelike FPS with robot cowboys, speedy parkour, and devastating synergies. Grapple, slide, and swing as you hunt down enemy bandits on your flying train.

title: Wild Hive Demo
description: Build your own bee hive in this cozy roguelite. Hatch worker bees, forage nectar and sell your honey on the stock market. The royal crown demands more honey every year! Will your hive thrive or fall apart?

title: Hibera Requiem for the Forgotten Demo
Echoes of Kyria Demo
description: Fight solo or with up to 4 players co-op to take on massive bosses in this stylized 3D action rogue-like survivors-like. Step into Kyria, battle against relentless hordes, and master the dynamic, fast-paced combat.

title: Barnburners Demo
description: Arcade hockey like the '90s and '00s used to make, free to try. Four clubs, huge hits, and fights where you throw every punch, on the couch or online. You'll score in the first minute. Getting good is the hard part. The full game adds the other 20 clubs and franchise.

title: Christopher Ledger: Corporate Auditor Demo
description: Anime courtroom murder mystery, set in the corporate world. Interrogate executives, expose billion-dollar cover-ups, and audit your way to the truth.

title: Toy Worlds Atlas Demo
description: Toy Worlds Atlas is a colouring book game that explores philosophy through bizarre, artistic sandbox levels. Combine colours to solve riddles and discover secrets! Made for mindful breaks, each level subverts expectations and inspires thought. Comes with a desktop companion mode for work sessions

title: WheelJumper: The Art Of Edging Demo
Impossible Wonders Demo
description: Oversee a horde of tiny imps as they haphazardly build monuments in the imp lords honor. A cute and short arcade style game with a global leaderboard.

title: Angel Guardian Demo
description: Angel Guardian is a sci-fi side-scrolling action shooter set in a space station under attack. Play as Kita, a warrior guardian on a mission to rescue the young prince while fighting hostile enemies. Use shooting, stealth and hacking to face powerful bosses and prove yourself as a true guardian.

title: Tidy Up Together Demo
description: Catastrophe! An evil wizard has cast a tornado spell on your shop, and now all your products are on the floor. Maybe you'll ask some friends for help to tidy up?

title: All Our Broken Parts Demo
description: Experience a story-driven adventure game as a robot doctor. In a city of robots, illness is looming. Crack open ports and units to trace causes. Diagnose, repair and cross paths with robots and stories. Uncover secrets buried in the past and future, discover the truth that makes each robot unique.

title: Ride Up Together Demo
description: Ride, climb, kick, and survive! Ride Up Together is a chaotic 1-8 player online co-op motorcycle climbing game where every jump matters. Climb to the top, sabotage your friends with powerful kicks, survive crazy physics obstacles, and try not to fall all the way back down.

title: SURVIVOR 01 Demo
description: System boot. Run. Risk rising. Get weapon. Kill monsters. Loot. Loot. Loot. Died. Start again.

title: Guardian of soul tower Demo
description: Fight in real-time, build powerful elemental decks, and climb the Soul Tower in this dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Every death leaves behind a Nemesis Phantom created from your own deck, waiting to challenge you in future runs.

title: Capy of Gods Demo
description: A vertical-climbing action roguelike: scale a massive tower as a capybara while your weapons fire on their own, bullet-heaven style. Level up, shape your build, take on quests, and unlock weapons and characters. Every run generates a brand-new tower.

title: イケ勘 - イケメンになるかどうか勘で付き合うゲーム  -無料完結版-
TCG Shop Life Demo
description: Run your own TCG shop in TCG Shop Life: sell booster packs, hire staff, and customize your store. You can also open booster packs, build your own deck, and master strategic battles.

title: The UNDA Legacy Demo
description: Try the first 6 wave-physics puzzles in this atmospheric 3D demo. Explore the mysterious island of Roursus and begin uncovering the fate of a vanished research team. Master reflection and resonance in a calm world where science meets philosophy.

title: Freaking Gamers Demo
description: Freaking Gamers is a 2D beat 'em up featuring fully hand-drawn artwork and stages packed with references to the iconic jokes and episodes from the Colônia Contra Ataca channel. Join the Freaking Gamers as they battle to stop the evil plans of Vinet, "the largest internet company in the world."
developer: Gixer Entertainment, ColôniaContraAtaca, Open Eye Dash

title: Visual Novel Transformer Demo
description: 面向作者的视觉小说制作工具：用可视化编辑把小说变成可玩的视觉小说作品；可自行接入 AI 接口辅助配置内容，更快做出能试玩、能分享的互动故事。

title: Chess of the Hidden Gates Demo
Dead fighting card Demo
description: Unleash your boundless imagination to freely build a deck that's uniquely yours, then play cards to fend off wave after wave of monsters! What's more, the unique Relic System lets you equip your cards with all sorts of powerful relics, forging a fantastic playstyle that's entirely your own.

title: Teddy's Horde Demo
description: A top-down arena survival brawler. Pick a bear, drop into the arena, and hold out against escalating waves of wardens. demo  plays in ~5 minutes a run. Full game includes endless mode and local coop.

title: Rock From Home Demo
description: Name your rock, interact, customize wildly, and battle emails! A comedy sim where you actively earn money through your day job to pay for your foolish spendings.

title: Living is Expensive... Demo
description: “Defeat my sleep deprivation monsters, and I will cure your poverty virus.” Living is Expensive... is a visual novel about the cost of existence & minimum wage vampires. 🩸🍷💸😭🥹💀

title: Syncline Demo
description: A rolling-block puzzle where your piece is a whole line of cubes. Roll it flat, stand it on end, break it or rejoin it, and turn the camera to find the way — then land the chain along the goal line to cover it.

title: Huiyu AI 3D Video Demo
description: Huiyu AI 3D Video is a realtime AI 3D depth video viewer that generates depth maps during playback and renders ordinary videos as depth-driven 3D scenes, with TensorRT acceleration, local depth caching, realtime parameter tuning, fullscreen viewing, and WebXR VR support.

title: 掌中帝国 HANDSET HQ Demo
description: A pixel-art phone-maker tycoon sim. Start from a garage in Year One and run a company across four decades, through the feature-phone, smartphone and AI eras. Each model balances R&D, price, selling point, hardware and marketing, and sales are decided on launch.

title: CyberDeck Demo
description: Play the free Act I CyberDeck demo: a cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder with three operators that feel like different games. Blitz through fights as GG, rig loot-box odds as El Money, or power cards on the turn-based Beat as CyberMaster. Draft cards, install chrome, and beat the boss.

title: She Was First Demo
description: She Was First is a story-driven psychological horror game set in a quiet 1990s home. You play as Anna, a young girl spending an ordinary evening alone: eating food, feeding the cat, cleaning up, and getting ready for bed. But as the house grows darker, small moments begin to feel wrong.

title: Old Money Demo
description: Old Money is an elegant business & life simulation: start from almost nothing, build business empires, play the markets, amass real estate, found a dynasty and rise all the way into politics. A whole life – your decisions, right down to the legacy you pass on.

title: Conto de um Gato - Demo
description: Conto de um Gato é uma visual novel de fantasia urbana na capital do Brasil, onde nenhum gato é exatamente o que parece e decisões difíceis precisam ser tomadas.

title: (Spell+Fract) * Demo
description: (Spell+Fract) a Co-Op PVE Rougelike game about using math formulas to create spells of mass destruction and the better you are, the faster you cast, the more devistating the result.

title: Stellar Wreck Demo
description: Repair your spaceship, explore mysterious planets, battle strange creatures, and survive in this sci-fi sandbox RPG where every journey becomes a new adventure.

title: UberLoop Demo
description: Survive the clock, drop the bosses—that’s the run. Enemy swarms spike throughout the match, boss fights hit at set moments, and the music ramps up when things get ugly.UberLoop is a 3D top-down survivor with bullet-heaven combat—move, aim, and outlast escalating hordes while your build snowballs out of control.

title: Rebels of the Realm Demo
description: Grab your friends, pick your class, and raid dungeons in this lighthearted co-op fantasy RPG, where chaotic spells and hilariously bad ragdoll deaths keep the realm unpredictable.

title: The Taking Demo
description: Step into the opening chapter of The Taking, a retro-inspired survival horror game inspired by 90s classics. Explore a deserted British town, solve environmental puzzles, and survive encounters with the horrors that stalk the streets.

title: Who Killed Arthur? Demo
description: Who Killed Arthur? is an offbeat, murder-mystery, puzzle game telling a story of heartbreak, loss, body horror, and the fear of growing up. The game is rife with rich storytelling elements, strange, talking animals, curious children, and a killer original soundtrack to boot!

title: Sudoku Atlas Demo
description: The free demo of Sudoku Atlas. 28 handpicked puzzles from a gentle 4×4 up to a monumental 25×25, plus a new daily 9×9 that never runs out. Everything else is the complete app: no ads, no accounts, no internet. Unlock the full version once and own every puzzle forever.

title: Leafblade Demo
description: An ARPG monster caretaker. Fight along the Mons you meet in your adventure to recover the bond between humans and Mons. Take care of your Mons in your farm, improving their combat and farm skills while ensuring their happiness.

title: Obsidia Demo
description: Obsidia is inspired by Zelda, Hob and Silent Hill. You will have to survive vicious entities, rescue your coworkers, reveal what happened and save the people lost in the city of Sibodia. You will have to make choices from time to time, but you won't be promped to: the game will remember your actions

title: thimble dungeon demo
description: a snack-sized auto-battler roguelite. you pick the path, your heroes do the dying. fire the clutch abilities, draft run-changing cards, bank the fallen party's souls into permanent upgrades, and delve again. four biomes, three heroes, endless mode.

title: Flames Of Vulcan Demo
description: Flames of Vulcan: Demo is a gripping action-strategy game with deep gameplay and tactical combat. Expect dynamic gameplay, a remastered soundtrack, introductory levels, and a full arsenal of weapons. The demo is fully optimized and ready to play!

title: Rewritten:Chasing History Demo
description: The year is 2050. You're failing History and P.E. — so your teacher drops you into an AI simulation of the past. Chase down real historical figures, study who they truly were, and decide who history keeps. A cute catch-and-judge game with the soul of an ethics class.

title: Vonkelveld Demo
description: Shape a living world in Vonkelveld's free two-act demo. Tend the First Valley, follow individual souls, then face a featured Long Winter with seven divine powers. People choose for themselves, the Chronicle remembers, and your save can continue in the full game.

title: The Christmas Shift Demo
description: The Christmas Shift is a cozy horror game where you work the holiday shift at a local café. Prepare hot drinks, serve fresh pastries, and keep your customers happy.

title: sys:tan restore Demo
description: A (very) short incremental game where you blast shapes to solve computer problems. Put together a party of computer caretakers with their own unique skill trees and give the system a deep clean!

title: Moonlight Duels Demo
description: Face off in tense one-on-one gun duels where every step counts. Walk toward your opponent, time your shot, activate powerful abilities, and outsmart your rival in a deadly game of nerve.

title: The Box Project Demo
description: A short first-person experimental game with comedy elements. You are given one simple task: supervise a box. Listen to a voice over the speakers, face a test built around attention and simple rules, and try not to prove that modern players can fail at anything.

title: Apothecary Grounds Demo
description: No memory. No way out. Just a graveyard, a sealed crypt, and the Apothecary who hunts you. Explore the abandoned grounds, collect what you need to open the door, and discover the mystery hidden beneath the stone.

title: Nightmere Demo
description: The year is 1989. Amelia finds herself at AECC, a community center and pool, to solve a missing persons case. A bright and up-and-coming detective, this case will undoubtedly serve as the starting point for a long series of events that Amelia will carry with her into Nightmere years later.

title: The Swamp Daughter Demo
description: Embark on Julia’s journey in this 2.5D eco-apocalyptic adventure of choices, exploration, and puzzles. Explore a dangerous swamp and face tough choices while you uncover her past in this intriguing tale of identity and survival.

title: Necromancer Idle: The Endless Drain Demo
description: Defeat The Necromancer and free the world from his evil! An Idle/Incremental inspired by RPGs and Roguelites: die and rise again keeping your innate experience, automate your actions and grow stronger with every life. This demo includes the complete first chapter.

title: Send Them Fly Demo
description: SEND THEM FLY is a physics-driven zombie survival roguelite where every enemy can become a projectile. Blast through endless hordes, stack wild upgrades, trigger explosive chain reactions, and turn the apocalypse into a low-poly playground of ragdoll chaos.

title: North Pole Workshop Demo
description: For 1-4 players. Play as one of Santa’s elves to create, giftwrap, and deliver toys. Transport, haul, or throw raw materials into magical machines. Craft adorable teddy bears, rocking horses, and more. Unlimited time for completing levels with 1 star. For 3 stars, be quick and strategic.

title: CHANNEL ZERO Demo
description: DEMO - As a detective, you are tasked with tracking down a convicted criminal. The trail leads to the remains of an abandoned television studio. Explore the studio as you track down the suspect. The longer you investigate, the clearer it becomes that you both are not alone...

title: Meow Star Archives Demo
description: In this 2D puzzle game, you need to restore the cats’ severely damaged memory archives to stop their souls from fading away. As you restore the archives, you’ll uncover the heartfelt stories of these lovely kitties before they journey back to the stars.

title: I.T.C.B - Interstellar Trade Compliance Bureau Demo
Chrome Circuit Demo
description: Neon twin-stick roguelite. Fight through three cyberpunk districts with an infinite-ammo sidearm and a five-slot arsenal of looted guns. Bait bosses into mistakes, beat the clock in timed encounters, sign cursed contracts. This demo is the full game — saving unlocks at launch.

title: Garbage King Demo
description: A short turn-based resource management and strategy roguelike where you manage a collapsing empire. Gather resources, construct buildings, manage your army, survive disasters, and keep the empire alive!

title: Damn Adventure Demo
description: Damn Adventure is a Flash game-style 2D action Metroidvania. Swap between three unique characters as you take down enemies and explore a sprawling world. Your adventure starts now.

title: Space Cargo Simulator Demo
description: Transport cargo in this challenging journey through space! Listen to your co-pilot's warnings; manage your fuel; and contend with gravity, physics, and meteors. Use the money you earn from deliveries to expand your fleet with brand-new, massive ships!

title: Palisade Demo
description: Unite the Northern Realms, carry the Great Army across the North Sea, and break the fortified powers of the Seine in a free three-battle strategy saga. Expand, build, and conquer across historical maps.

title: Now With More Plunk Demo
description: A Plinko-like incremental where your coins strum harps, hit drums, and eventually create their own master orchestra. Go Plunk it up!

title: Clickendo Demo
description: Click cards, build a coin-generating deck, unlock suits and permanent perks, and chase huge multipliers in this incremental card clicker.

title: DeckTerra Demo
description: A Medieval 4X Deckbuilder. Lead a kingdom as you build your deck to conquer the map and expand your rule. Develop your technology through the middle ages to improve your army of knights and keep your peasants happy. Develop your trade, religion, science, and military to conquer the continent.

title: Bracer Demo
description: Grab a buddy and brace for chaos in this 3D Fantasy Shoot ‘Em Up (SHMUP). Face off against a twisted necromancer fueled by a cursed bracer and a bloodlust for destruction. Blast enemies, dodge projectiles, unlock upgrades, and customize your hero with unique weapons, skills, and skins.

title: The Walk of Karl Demo

description: The City Of Akhetaten highoctane Isometric Action RPG that seamlessly fuses fastpaced Hack Slash combat with deep survival resource gathering and sandbox base-building. Choose your class explore ancient lands build your village from scratch and survive against ruthless hordes across mystical realms!

title: Medieval Ascendant - Prologue
description: From a serf bound to the soil to the head of a noble house. Farm, trade, build an economic empire across five provinces, claim land through war, intrigue or wealth — and forge a dynasty that outlives you.

clear cherry ice Demo
description: Did I really save this pretty boy ten years ago...? A fresh summer youth BL visual novel about memory, promises, and mutual salvation. [clear cherry ice.] Get closer to Jiwon and Chaehyun, and see whether your bond becomes friendship—or something more.

description: In the demo for this single-player narrative roguelite, govern a cursed island as you investigate your niece’s mysterious disappearance. Interrogate, trade, upgrade, and embark upon card-based expeditions to uncover dark secrets – before the next cataclysm strikes.

title: Kings of Oros Demo
description: Kings of Oros combines deep build customization with momentum-driven marble physics. Watch your stone soldiers violently clatter, bounce, and shatter as you craft game breaking builds. Instead of grids and dice rolls, experience real physics battles. Control the chaos with endless build variety.

title: CRYMELIGHT Demo
description: This is the demo version of CRYMELIGHT, a roguelike action game set in the afterlife, where girls burdened by sin fight for freedom while confronting their own sins.

description: Hunt birds in the Farm biome, master your weapon, and climb the online leaderboard. The demo offers a first look at Pluck Em!’s fast-paced arcade action, with additional biomes, weapons, upgrades, and features available to preview in the menus.

description: Baue Rohstoffe im All ab, erweitere dein Frachtschiff und errichte Produktionsketten, Stationen und Handelsrouten. In Oreship Stellar Frontier wächst dein Weltraumimperium Schritt für Schritt über mehrere Sternensysteme hinweg.

title: Tales of Kathay Demo
description: Tales of Kathay is a tactical turn-based RPG where every world is born from centuries of simulated history. Explore ruined kingdoms, join faction wars, craft your path through a living sandbox, and return generations later to see the mark your choices left behind.

title: Now or Later Demo
description: In Now Or Later, a Zelda-like adventure game, you can make any locked door, enemy, or even an entire dungeon disappear into thin air. But beware—every shortcut has its consequences.

title: Fully Automated Demo
description: Fully Automated is a fast paced action roguelite. Destroy or demoralize your foes, and shape the future of your world ! Face relentless waves of enemies and choose from a variety of upgrades and traits to create the perfect style. Will you be a force for peace or a demon of war?

title: Evolve: Dead City Demo
description: The city has fallen. Scavenge supplies, arm yourself, secure logistics, and build your base in a metropolis overrun by the undead. Uncover the truth behind the outbreak and command zombie workers who never complain, never tire, and never ask for wages. Demo is not final quality.

description: A free sample of Ego Lifting Simulator: physically control every rep, build muscle, manage a short career slice, and compete in your first regional lifting meet.

title: Little Critter Hunters Demo
description: Lead your party of Little Critter Hunters and wipe out every enemy before the timer hits zero. Complete quests, learn new skills, and venture deeper into the world in this short and snappy incremental game.

description: Grab your headphones and step up to the turntable in Scratch The Cat - a vibrant action-adventure 3D platformer. Play as DJ Scratch, explore a sprawling musical world, fight bosses, and reclaim your stolen records. Turn up the volume and set the stage for the purr-fect comeback.

description: A chaotic roguelike pachinko game where you build absurd ball upgrades and watch physics-driven chain reactions explode across the board. Every run evolves into a different machine of bouncing, splitting, and cascading score chaos.

description: Traverse a wonderful and strange world of cubes shrouded in fog in PITH, a 3D metroidvania adventure. Find tools to help delve deeper and uncover secrets that were hiding in plain sight.

title: Huiyu Teach AI Demo
description: A little desktop toy where you teach an AI how to do something — just by typing. You type out a thing — how to take a shower, which hand goes in first — and the AI takes a guess, tries to figure out what you meant, and shows you what it came up with. Whether it got it right is up to you to judge.

title: Angel Told Me Demo
description: A free demo of Angel Told Me — a fast, brutal retro FPS with RPG progression. Fight through the first four maps as one of three callings, upgrade your arsenal, and face the Toad King in the mire.

description: Experience the core gameplay of VoxelDynasties in this single-player demo. Build your civilization through seven ages, command armies, develop technologies, and battle AI opponents with the full range of units and mechanics.

title: Deskpot Demo
description: A mini idle-farming game the size of one pot. Each keystroke turns into water for your little plant. Put it anywhere on your screen, harvest plants and upgrade your pot. While you're busy with other things, your hard work will bear fruit!

title: Escape from Prompt: Rogue AI Demo
Net Worthless Demo
description: A satirical life-and-money sim. One turn is one month: budget your hours, work the job, ride the market, outlive inflation and your own decisions. In the demo you play one character, the Student, start to finish: make their dream come true. Or at least don't die trying.

description: The free demo of DICE & DARE: the push-your-luck dice roguelike, uncut. Roll, push, bank across 8 rounds, build your engine with charms, relics and Jokers, and set a record. The full game's climb is ENDLESS. How far will you dare to push?

title: Lucky Pocket Demo
description: Adjust your strategy to match the shop list that changes with every playthrough, combine equipment to create powerful synergies, and defeat monsters and bosses with a variety of options!

title: 星のなっちゃんW 体験版 (Hoshi_no_Natchan_W) Demo
description: This is a 2D platform action game where you dash, jump, and attack your way through the stages.

title: Kairos: Until the Dawn Breaks Demo

title: Bull Gone Wild Demo
description: Play as a bull where you build momentum, chain attacks, and slam into enemies as everything around you explode into chaos. It’s all about feeling powerful, out of control in a good way, and turning every fight into something loud, messy, and fun.

description: You're no hero — you're the warden of the Old God Dungeon. Dig mazes, evolve monsters, and sacrifice intruders to the Old God. Riot. Counterattack. Wishlist now!

description: The Crazy Eights roguelike. Every 8 is wild: call the suit, keep the chain alive, and cash out monster combos. Build decks that bend the rules, stack House Rules that multiply each other, and break the casino one floor at a time.

description: 'Soul Cake' is a multi-ending romance exploration AVG game, mainly featuring visual novel gameplay and exploration collection. The main character is female and it includes lesbian, femdom,various love themes, and female-dominated elements.

description: Shoot, slash and slay the enemy hordes erupting from the jungle’s Membrane in this action survival roguelite. Hold the encircling trenches, fortify them, choose your build and rise from loinclothed-servant to unstoppable Amazon king.
